page.title: kTranslationHelper demo
hero.title: Help us translate this page
hero.lead: This page is available in several languages. Turn on translation mode, then hold Shift and click any highlighted text to correct it or translate it into another language.
hero.step1: Turn on translation mode with the button at the top of the page.
hero.step2: Hold Shift and click any highlighted text.
hero.step3: Correct the text, or pick another language and translate it.
hero.backendStatic: This copy of the demo has no backend, so suggestions are not saved.
hero.backendPhp: This copy of the demo uses the PHP backend. Suggestions are written straight into the JSON translation files.
hero.resetDone: The translation files have been reset.
ex.title: Examples
ex.text.title: Plain text
ex.text.body: Headings, paragraphs and list items are the simplest case. Each element carries its translation key in a data-i18n attribute.
ex.links.title: Links and buttons
ex.links.body: Links and buttons keep working as normal. Only Shift + click opens the editor, so you can keep browsing while translation mode is on.
ex.vars.title: Text with placeholders
ex.vars.body: Some strings contain placeholders that the app fills in. The editor shows the raw template and warns you if a placeholder goes missing.
ex.attrs.title: Attributes
ex.attrs.body: Placeholders, tooltips and image descriptions can be translated too. Shift + click the search field, the help button or the picture.
ex.attrs.imageAlt: A loaf of sourdough bread on a wooden board
ex.nested.title: Several strings in one place
ex.nested.body: This button has a label and a tooltip. When you Shift + click it, the editor asks which one you want to translate.
ex.nested.tooltip: Saves your changes without publishing them
ex.html.title: Formatted text
ex.html.body: HTML can be allowed for individual strings. This sentence contains a link and bold text, and the editor lets you edit the markup.
ex.html.sentence: By placing an order you agree to our terms of sale and our privacy policy.
ex.dynamic.title: Content added later
ex.dynamic.body: Highlighting is done with CSS, so text that appears after the page has loaded is highlighted automatically.
ex.dynamic.n2: Your order is on its way.
ex.hidden.title: Hidden text
ex.hidden.body: Some text is hard to click, such as dropdown options, collapsed sections and the page title. Use “All text” on the translation badge to find it.
ex.hidden.details: We deliver between 8am and 6pm. You will get a text message an hour before we arrive.
ex.mixed.title: Mixed languages
ex.mixed.body: This quote is always shown in Spanish, whatever language the page is in. Its lang attribute tells the helper which language it is correcting.
ex.mixed.quote: Traveller, there is no road; the road is made by walking.
ex.missing.title: Missing translations
ex.missing.body: When a string has not been translated, this demo shows the English text instead and marks it in red. Switch to Spanish to see two missing strings, or to French to see a language that has not been translated yet.
ex.pages.title: Across pages
ex.pages.body: Translation mode stays on as you move around the site, and the editor remembers the last language you translated into. Try the other pages:
ex.ignore.title: Excluded text
ex.ignore.body: Some text must not be changed here, such as legal wording. The plugin leaves it alone: no highlighting, no editor.
ex.ignore.notice: Prices include VAT. Offers are subject to availability. Only the legal team may change this notice.
about.title: Baking bread the slow way since 1998
about.lead: We are a small family bakery. Every loaf is shaped by hand and left to rise overnight.
about.story.title: Our story
about.story.p1: It started in a tiny kitchen with one oven and a jar of sourdough starter that is still going today.
about.story.p2: Today {count} bakers work in shifts so that the first loaves are ready when we open at seven.
about.stats.title: In numbers
about.values.title: What we care about
about.values.v1.title: Local flour
about.values.v1.body: All our flour comes from mills less than 100 km away.
about.values.v2.title: Nothing wasted
about.values.v2.body: Whatever is left at closing time goes to the food bank down the road.
about.values.v3.title: Time
about.values.v3.body: Long, slow fermentation makes bread that tastes better and keeps for longer.
about.cta.text: Want to learn how we do it? We run bread-making classes every month.
contact.title: Get in touch
contact.lead: Questions about an order, or want to book a bread-making class? Send us a message.
contact.form.title: Send a message
contact.form.name: Name
contact.form.required: Please fill in your name and a message.
contact.form.sent: Thanks, {name}! We'll reply within one working day.
contact.form.demoNote: This form is part of the demo and doesn't send anything.
